title: Plato loadcurve generator and correlated tail-event analyzer
author: Mariana Ortiz
description: Motivation: reproducing correlated tail events in our synthetic workloads has been brittle; standard generators model marginal latency distributions but not cross-feature correlation spikes (e.g. KV cache miss storms combined with GPU scheduling pressure) so engineers lacked a reliable repro for p99+ regressions. This PR introduces 'Plato' — a parametric loadcurve generator plus a correlated tail-event analyzer that produces quantile-by-feature heatmaps and an event list suitable for automated triage. Design summary: Plato provides composable traffic profiles (sine/ramp/step/gaussian-burst and poisson-modulated mixes), an inter-request correlation layer (context IDs, locality knobs, synthetic fanout patterns), and an instrumentation surface that tags requests with feature vectors (seq_len, prompt_token_entropy, cache_hint, shard_id). The analyzer ingests traces and metrics, computes conditional quantiles (p50/p95/p99) grouped by features, and emits CSV/Parquet heatmaps and a JSON event list for the reporting pipeline. Integration: plugs into existing runner harness via a new runner_plato adapter (opt-in via --profile=plato) and into the reporting pipeline as a postprocess step. Backwards compatibility: no default behavior changes; existing runners are unaffected unless the profile flag is used. Tests and validation: added deterministic unit tests (seeded RNG), a lightweight nightly e2e job that runs a condensed 1M-request synthetic sweep, and a local perf-canary scenario for developers. CI: new pytest module and a small Rust telemetry collector binary were added; one flaky assertion on the sampler was stabilized. Release notes: adds a new benchmark generator and analyzer aimed at reproducing and diagnosing correlated tail events; recommended for perf investigations and regression triage. Checklist: [x] design doc linked ENG-7246; [x] unit tests; [x] integration job; [x] docs; [x] reporting consumer. Related: ENG-6101 (latent KV cache metrics refactor) and PERF-issues flagged by nightly runs.
commits: init: add plato generator and analyzer modules
tests: add seeded unit tests and integration harness
ci: add nightly plato pipeline and telemetry collector

review_comments: Ethan Zhao: Nice API surface. Can we expose a 'burstiness' hyperparam and document expected p99 amplification? Author: added burstiness param and noted its effect in docs (plato.md).

Ravi Kapoor: The Rust telemetry binary increases CI matrix time. Can we build it conditionally? Author: switched to a prebuilt artifact in CI for linux-amd64 to keep test time low; retained source for dev builds.

Lina Patel: Analyzer uses a lot of memory when grouping by 10+ features; can we cap cardinality? Author: added a config knob max_cardinality and a streaming group-eviction policy to bound memory (default 100).
QA: ran the nightly e2e and validated heatmap artifacts load in the dashboard; one CSV column name mismatch fixed in follow-up commit.
release_notes: Adds 'Plato' synthetic loadcurve generator and correlated tail-event analyzer. Use --profile=plato to opt in. Produces heatmaps and event reports for triage and regression debugging.
